simple.summary: נְבוּשַׁזְבָּן (Nᵉbûwshazbân) means Nebushazban , Nebuchadnezzar's chief eunuch First listed occurrence: Jer 39 13.

definitions.full: H5021. Nebushaz -ban נְבוּשַׁזְבַֿן proper name, masculine (= Nabû-šêzib-anni, Nebo delivers me , Schr COT Jer 39:13 ); — officer of Nebuchadrezzar, called רַבסָֿרִים (q. v.) 39:13 .
